items.name: fade
items.title: Fade
items.description: A frame-synced opacity primitive for deterministic Remotion entrances, exits, and crossfades.

items.name: slide
items.title: Slide
items.description: A frame-synced directional translation primitive for Remotion entrances and motion composition.

items.name: scale
items.title: Scale
items.description: A frame-synced scale primitive with configurable start, duration, and endpoints.

items.name: blur
items.title: Blur
items.description: A frame-synced blur primitive that composes with existing CSS filters.

items.name: stagger
items.title: Stagger
items.description: Offsets child sequences by a fixed number of frames so nested Remotion primitives receive local frame time.

items.name: enter-exit
items.title: Enter Exit
items.description: A full-lifecycle opacity and translation wrapper for deterministic scene entrances and exits.
